ratings_why.fun: Every buy and sell is a vote on seat count against water height, and the growth climbs steadily into a real Tier 5 chase; turns 1 to 4 feel thin while dilution bites.
ratings_why.distinct: Earns 8 over 7 because one shared Health stat for the whole tribe, with Under drowning your own outsiders too, plays unlike any Battlegrounds tribe or generic auto-battler tribe.

verdict_why: The tiers do their jobs and growth is linear by design; what is left is one stacking line and owner balancing, so more rounds would make it different, not better.

points.text: Meester Kobus Bles doesn't say what two copies do (twice, three times or four). Add a line, for example that a second Kobus adds nothing, as with Brann.

With Hendrika's raise behind it, the Peilmeester's Start of Combat clears most late enemy boards before a single attack. The Risks section already names the lever (Level minus Health); keep it ready for the owner's pass.
Turns 1 to 4 are the soft spot: Bench Coot at 1 Health drags the Level down. A Tier 1 or Tier 2 unit that pours when played would make the first buys feel like adding water, not losing it.

Levy-Master against the Peilmeester is a great tension: outsiders pay the levy but drown at high water. A Tier 3 or Tier 4 card that protects or fattens outsiders would give High Water a second path besides the Heemraad.

standouts.why: Heemraad turns any unit from another tribe into water, and makes each slot a real choice between seated and paying the levy.
Aaltje Sluiswacht makes lowering the water a vote too, turning Health into Attack across the bench.
The Spaarndam Pup takes the law into combat: the board breaks all at once or not at all.

weakest.why: Bench Coot's 1 Health dilutes the Level on turn 1 or 2, when the tribe is already thin.
Nest-Platform Coot's 1/1 Chicks are low output for Tier 3 outside the sell and death builds.
Eel-Trap Coot is a flat gold tap that doesn't care which way you vote the water.

flags.note: The Miller with Kobus makes End of Turn Pours x4, and goldens x9; Levy-Master then pours about 80 a turn at Tier 5. Linear, but the high roll to watch.
With a high Level, especially with Hendrika, it can wipe most of a wide enemy board at Start of Combat with no in-fight answer.
Golden Hendrika doubles the Level, and with a golden Peilmeester everything under four times the base Level drowns.
Stacking with a second Kobus is not stated.
